_comment: Marketing screenshot captions per language. Each shot: title lines (the last one is boxed in gold) and a subline. Used by tool/store_kit.mjs.

city.sub: Every walk paints the map. The rest stays white.

stages.sub: Your walks, ranked S to C for new ground.

clear.sub: Time, pace and how much of the city you uncovered.

spots.sub: Press and hold the map. Walks collect them.

record.sub: Live fog, live stats, a ring that fills with new ground.

offline.sub: Download it once. The map is instant, no signal needed.

city.sub: 歩いた道だけ地図に色がつく。残りは真っ白。

record.sub: 霧が晴れ、リングが新しい道で満ちていく。

offline.sub: 一度ダウンロードすれば電波なしでも即表示。
